title: Gaming Days Out: Arcades, VR and Retro Games for Teens
description: Gaming days out for teens and families: seaside arcades, retro gaming, VR experiences, game-themed exhibitions and how to set a sensible budget.
h1: Gaming days out: arcades, VR and retro games
intro: Got a gamer? Turn screen time into a day out with arcades, VR experiences and retro games, together.

image.alt: A neon sign for escape rooms

cardText: Arcades, VR and retro gaming, with budget tips.

blocks.title: Scout’s gamer tip
blocks.text: Load a fixed amount onto a play card and stop when it’s gone. Arcades are designed to keep you spending!
points: Look for family hours at gaming cafés

sections.html: From 2p machines to air hockey and dance games, seaside arcades are a classic. Pair them with a free beach day: see beaches and seaside.
Virtual reality arenas let teams play together in headsets. They usually have minimum ages, so check before booking.
Super Nintendo World at Epic Universe (and other Universal parks) brings games to life. Science and design museums sometimes host gaming exhibitions. Check museums and science.

faqs.q: What age is VR suitable for?
faqs.a: Many VR venues and headset makers set minimum ages. Check the venue’s rules before booking.
